[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Wachten''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who accompanied [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Lariss]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]] to act as the Major's "[[Wrathor]]" during the meeting with the [[Rajah]] and [[Royal Court]]. Large and possessed of a broad face, he was loud and harsh. He carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].
